note: Primary forecast family includes all full-period MSE comparisons, including alternate intraday variants; yearly/section and QLIKE checks are diagnostics, not independent confirmatory discoveries. This family was assembled exhaustively, not selected for significance. Coefficient sign-bootstrap p values are approximate; intervals are marginal, not simultaneous.
